recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. The current combined source satisfies FHIR-26358 after the earlier HTTP prose application and the already-published FHIR-31965 example correction; no further core source work is recommended.
issue_request: FHIR-26358 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked that conditional create responses identify the existing resource when exactly one match prevents creation, and the final resolution expanded the clarification to conditional update with mandatory Location metadata when a record is created or updated.
initial_application: The issue was applied by c32a2adb0774d63553808f9e2b551292292e7fed, which changed source/http.html so successful update, conditional update, and conditional create paths require create-like Location metadata. A later same-family issue, FHIR-31965, clarified the exact one-match conditional-create prose in f9b3cf00eec480a65fa6963c978a330ce2d57946.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2020-06-29 record agreement that there is value in telling the client which existing resource prevented creation. The active Bundle response example cited by FHIR-26358 had remained stale, but the combined branch already contains fb1b37f11fcf4e918578390e1d2c3b10282fffc3 for FHIR-31965, updating source/bundle/bundle-response.xml to show the matched resource plus Location, ETag, and Last-Modified. Exact Zulip search for FHIR-26358 found no direct messages; the related FHIR-31965 Zulip thread supports the same response-metadata interpretation and revealed no conflict.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/http.html requires Location for successful created/updated resource versions and says a one-match conditional create returns 200 OK with headers and body populated as if a create occurred. Current source/bundle/bundle-response.xml now shows the existing Patient resource and response metadata for the matched conditional create.
